claim: In Zorn v. Linton (2025), the incident stemmed from the January 8, 2015 inauguration of Governor Peter Shumlin at the Vermont state capitol.
evidence: On January 8, 2015, Vermont hosted the inauguration for Governor Peter Shumlin in the capitol.
excerpt:
On the Governor’s inauguration day in Vermont, protest - ers staged a sit-in at the state capitol.

I On January 8, 2015, Vermont hosted the inauguration for Governor Peter Shumlin in the capitol. 1 About 200 protest - ers attended, and some of them staged a sit-in to demand universal healthcare.

Sergeant Jacob Zorn used a “ ‘pain compliance tech - nique’ ” called a rear wristlock on Shela Linton, a nonviolent protestor who was peacefully demonstrating at a sit-in in the Vermont capitol. 135 F. 4th 19, 24–25 CA2 (2025). The Second Circuit held that Zorn was not entitled to qualified immunity
